releases.notes:
Music Player **2.7.1.351.port.10.2** for Minecraft **1.20.1–26.3**.

### Changes

- Added native Forge ports for every supported version with an official Forge release: 16 targets. Minecraft 1.21.2 has no official Forge release. Fabric and NeoForge each retain all 17 targets.
- SoundCloud now preserves track authorization when resolving audio streams and refreshes metadata before playback, including restored playlists and unlisted track URLs.
- Supported MIME types with parameters are recognized correctly. Inaccessible streams returning 401/403/404 fall back to another supported format; rate limits and unavailable tracks remain bounded errors.
- Fixed audio-thread shutdown when Lavaplayer wraps and clears an interrupt.
- Existing playlist serialization remains compatible. **YouTube source code is unchanged.**

### Downloads

Choose **one JAR** matching your Minecraft version and loader; remove the previous Music Player JAR from `mods`.

- **Forge:** 16 individual JARs, one per Minecraft version.
- **NeoForge:** 17 individual JARs, one per Minecraft version.
- **Fabric:** 10 grouped JARs covering 17 versions. Version ranges are included in filenames.
- `Music-Player-port.10.2-Fabric-exact.zip` contains the 17 optional exact-version Fabric JARs. Choose either a grouped JAR or an exact-version JAR.
- `Music-Player-port.10.2-sources.zip` contains the clean source tree from the release commit, including build scripts, pinned dependency artifacts and license notices. Build output, local caches, development runs and logs are excluded.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists checksums for the uploaded files.

### Verification

All **50 builds**, **33 offline regression suites** and release packaging checks passed.
All **16 Forge client GUI scenarios** passed: 13 loaded the packaged release JAR and embedded audio libraries in a development client; three older Forge targets ran compiled sources in a development client.

Further client runs were stopped at the maintainer's request. Live provider authentication/playback, audio quality, in-world behavior and the native file chooser UI are outside the GUI scenario. SoundCloud regressions use a local HTTP fixture and the real audio library.

Detailed results are attached as `build-results.json` and `forge-gui-results.json`, and recorded in the source tree under `ports/verification/`.

releases.notes:
## Native loaders added to port.10

- NeoForge now covers all 17 Minecraft releases in the matrix: 1.20.1, 1.21.1-1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3.
- Forge builds are included for 1.20.1, 1.21.1 and 1.21.3. There is no official Forge release for 1.21.2; use its NeoForge build.
- Added Fabric 1.21.1. All Fabric downloads include the GUI layout fix.
- All variants remain port.10, preserving search, sorting, playlists, equalizer, ordered folder imports, YouTube sign-in and source routing.
- Native ports register keys, HUD, screen controls, client ticks and audio shutdown through their own loader. Fabric API is required only for Fabric builds.

## Downloads

Install **one** Music Player JAR matching both your loader and exact Minecraft version/range.
There are 30 mod downloads: ten Fabric JARs, three Forge JARs and seventeen NeoForge JARs.

| Minecraft | Forge baseline | NeoForge baseline | Java |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.20.1 | 47.4.26 | 47.1.106 | 17 |
| 1.21.1 | 52.1.16 | 21.1.256 | 21 |
| 1.21.2 | — | 21.2.1-beta | 21 |
| 1.21.3 | 53.1.12 | 21.3.97 | 21 |
| 1.21.4 | — | 21.4.158 | 21 |
| 1.21.5 | — | 21.5.98 | 21 |
| 1.21.6 | — | 21.6.20-beta | 21 |
| 1.21.7 | — | 21.7.25-beta | 21 |
| 1.21.8 | — | 21.8.54 | 21 |
| 1.21.9 | — | 21.9.16-beta | 21 |
| 1.21.10 | — | 21.10.64 | 21 |
| 1.21.11 | — | 21.11.45 | 21 |
| 26.1 | — | 26.1.0.19-beta | 25 |
| 26.1.1 | — | 26.1.1.15-beta | 25 |
| 26.1.2 | — | 26.1.2.114 | 25 |
| 26.2 | — | 26.2.0.88 | 25 |
| 26.3 | — | 26.3.0.57-beta | 25 |

NeoForge versions marked `beta` are prerelease loader releases. NeoForge 1.20.1 uses the original Forge namespace/package layout, while later ports use native NeoForge APIs.

Fabric requires Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and the matching Fabric API from `ports/targets.json`; 1.21.1 uses 0.116.17+1.21.1. For grouped Fabric JARs install Fabric API for your actual Minecraft version.

## GUI validation and fix

Fixed the YouTube sign-in button overlapping the playback timeline in settings on every port.

The GUI integration scenario passed on all 37 exact Minecraft/loader combinations: 17 Fabric, 3 Forge and 17 NeoForge. Each run opens the actual Minecraft client and invokes GUI mouse/key handlers on its render thread. The scenario covers playlist creation/deletion, opening screens, loading a local WAV and an HTTP WAV, file/folder import buttons, adding individual/all tracks, playback controls, all six sorting choices, settings toggles/sliders/language, sign-in screen with Skip, and equalizer controls.

The 16 modern NeoForge runs load the packaged release JAR and its bundled audio dependencies in a development client. Fabric, Forge and NeoForge 1.20.1 use their compiled development client sources. All 30 release archives were also checked for metadata, Java compatibility, resources, licenses, bundled audio dependencies and production remapping.

**Limits:** the native operating-system chooser UI is not exercised; fixture chooser replies exercise the real file/folder GUI callbacks. Authenticated music-provider searches/sign-in and external service availability are not tested. This is GUI/track-loading coverage, not a full gameplay or audio-quality test.

Source snapshot: [80b19b9](https://github.com/misaki-schulz/Music-Player-port/commit/80b19b93873b8a0879f34f2e0538d6a7a0c420dc). Reproducible GUI scenario and per-target results: `ports/client-gui/`. Download `Music-Player-port.10-sources.zip` for updated sources. The existing port.10 release and tag are retained. `manifest.json`, `source-manifest.json` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` describe and hash all attached downloads.
